methods.clock: monotonic start before first workload read to complete canonical validation; tokenizer excluded; CLI includes process launches, shell parsing, jq and local reads; MCP driver wall may include process launches as wall_note records. No model reasoning or write transition.

tokenizer.measure: exact raw payload tokenizer count, not billed model usage

methods.token_count: sum cl100k_base encode(text, [], []) for each exact serialized request and raw HTTP response; CLI command plus stdin and stdout/stderr; unique per-count input files. Payload input plus output, static text separate. Neither count is observed consumed/billed context.
methods.hashes: SHA-256 over compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON. IDs sorted; fields recursively sorted, pageInfo omitted; connection nodes sorted by id, history arrays retain order. Cross-route field hashes are not comparable when shapes or cuts differ.
methods.pagination: first=250 for issues/comments/teams/labels; first=50 for projects/cycles; nested first=10, then first=250 only when hasNextPage; continue until false, reject null/repeated cursors and duplicate IDs. Forced size=2 control returns three IDs in two pages.
methods.missing_clock: audit comments resumed separately and roadmap/cycle old canonicalizer failed. Journal start spans exclude last response; no clock reconstructed from them.
methods.cycle_clock_completion: frozen client imported unchanged; only local global ceiling 220 and cycle reservation 5 overridden; no retries; two five-request runs; a new continuation would refuse.
methods.privacy: Public schema and query definitions persist. Private rows, IDs, text, credentials and cache stay untracked. This artifact preserves arithmetic and completeness evidence, not private payload replay. Reproduction requires authorized live data.
methods.hosts: Hosted worktree: personal key and CLI. Control VM: supplied pre-minted application token and official MCP. Split hosts and time cuts prevent transport-only latency attribution.
methods.journal_timestamp: finish.at copies request-start at; not a response-receipt timestamp. Only separately measured monotonic run clocks establish reported retrieval wall time.

graphql_query_definitions.actor: query Actor { viewer { id name email } }
graphql_query_definitions.ids: query IDs($filter:IssueFilter,$first:Int!,$after:String) { issues(filter:$filter,first:$first,after:$after,includeArchived:false) { nodes { id identifier } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
graphql_query_definitions.comments: query Comments($filter:CommentFilter,$first:Int!,$after:String) { comments(filter:$filter,first:$first,after:$after) { nodes { id body createdAt updatedAt user { name } issue { identifier } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
graphql_query_definitions.teams: query Teams($first:Int!,$after:String) { teams(first:$first,after:$after,filter:{key:{eq:"KEN"}}) { nodes { id name key } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
graphql_query_definitions.labels: query Labels($first:Int!,$after:String) { issueLabels(first:$first,after:$after) { nodes { id name description isGroup parent { id name } team { id name key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
graphql_query_definitions.projects: query Projects($first:Int!,$after:String) { projects(first:$first,after:$after,includeArchived:false,filter:{accessibleTeams:{some:{key:{eq:"KEN"}}}}) { nodes { id name description content state sortOrder teams(first:10) { nodes { id name key } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } relations(first:10) { nodes { id type anchorType relatedAnchorType relatedProject { id name state progress } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } inverseRelations(first:10) { nodes { id type anchorType relatedAnchorType project { id name state progress } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
graphql_query_definitions.cycles: query Cycles($first:Int!,$after:String) { cycles(first:$first,after:$after,filter:{team:{key:{eq:"KEN"}}}) { nodes { id number name startsAt endsAt progress scopeHistory completedScopeHistory issueCountHistory completedIssueCountHistory } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
graphql_query_definitions.project_relations: query ProjectRelations($id:String!,$first:Int!,$after:String) { project(id:$id) { relations(first:$first,after:$after) { nodes { id type anchorType relatedAnchorType relatedProject { id name state progress } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
graphql_query_definitions.project_inverse: query ProjectInverse($id:String!,$first:Int!,$after:String) { project(id:$id) { inverseRelations(first:$first,after:$after) { nodes { id type anchorType relatedAnchorType project { id name state progress } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
graphql_query_definitions.nested_labels: query Nested($id:String!,$first:Int!,$after:String) { issue(id:$id) { labels(first:$first,after:$after) { nodes { id name } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
graphql_query_definitions.nested_relations: query Nested($id:String!,$first:Int!,$after:String) { issue(id:$id) { relations(first:$first,after:$after) { nodes { id type relatedIssue { id identifier title state { name type } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
graphql_query_definitions.nested_inverseRelations: query Nested($id:String!,$first:Int!,$after:String) { issue(id:$id) { inverseRelations(first:$first,after:$after) { nodes { id type issue { id identifier title state { name type } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
